summary: DueByte 0.3.63 adds verified worker funding consents to the operator signing procedure in all three packages. It checks the current certified state, exact funding scope, node identity, consent expiry and duplicate commitments before signing. Signing creates a local receipt only; installation does not issue tokens, submit funding, start warmup or activate exchange. Existing chain, wallet keys, balances and signing history are retained. Home62 updates automatically; Linux Server requires coordinated manual installation. Windows executable is not Microsoft-code-signed; verify the signed DueByte channel. The candidate notice inside the immutable archive is superseded by this release notice.
